# ElementCycleException

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Thrown when an element contains itself, directly or through its descendants. Such a tree has no end, so it is rejected before layout instead of recursing until the stack overflows, which in .NET would end the process.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `BonniePdfException`.
